metadata.title: Demonstration of a novel method for measuring mass-loss rates for massive stars

notes: None of the paper's targets qualifies. The sample is explicitly selected as 20 bowshock-producing stars with secure distances, spectral types, and infrared photometry (T:p4-b4; T:p12-b0), not as Galactic-unbound candidates. The paper describes them as high-velocity/runaway stars and adopts a typical V_a = 30 km/s (T:p1-b5; T:p3-b1; T:p5-b2); it does not state or establish present-day unboundness from the Milky Way, nor report a prior Galactic-unbound identification.
